about: Meeting lines, as written and as speech recognition gives them, with what the attention, leave and cancel rules made of each for the default name. {Name} is where the name was said ({name} in lower case, {NAME} in capitals); {Variant}, {Variant2} and {Variant3} are other spellings of it (AGENT_NAME_VARIANTS), {Misheard} and {Misheard2} mishearings that are also words (AGENT_NAME_MISHEARD). "said" is what saidAfterName() found after the name, for the leave rule; leave, cancel and said are left out when false or empty. test/name-corpus.test.ts checks every line; npm run check-name tries them with another name. After a grammar change that is meant to change results, record them again with npm run record-name-corpus and review the diff. A few lines come from the tests of AMP (Apache License 2.0), with the name changed: see NOTICE.
